acclaim.en: The young scientist received acclaim for her clear and useful research.
acclaim.zh: 這位年輕科學家因清楚且實用的研究受到讚揚。

adhere.en: Students must adhere to the same safety rules during every experiment.
adhere.zh: 學生在每次實驗中都必須遵守相同的安全規定。

affluent.en: The article compares educational opportunities in affluent and less wealthy communities.
affluent.zh: 這篇文章比較富裕與較不富裕社區的教育機會。

ambiguous.en: The ambiguous instruction caused several groups to interpret the task differently.
ambiguous.zh: 模糊的指示讓幾個小組對任務有不同解讀。

anticipate.en: The team tried to anticipate possible problems before launching the project.
anticipate.zh: 團隊在啟動專案前試著預想可能發生的問題。

appealing.en: The new layout is visually appealing and easier to navigate.
appealing.zh: 新的版面在視覺上更吸引人，也更容易操作。

apprehend.en: Students may apprehend the main idea more easily after seeing the diagram.
apprehend.zh: 學生看過圖解後可能更容易理解主要概念。

assert.en: Writers should not assert a claim without enough supporting evidence.
assert.zh: 作者不應在缺乏充分證據時斷言某項主張。

attentive.en: An attentive reader notices small details that others may miss.
attentive.zh: 專心的讀者會注意到別人可能忽略的小細節。

boost.en: Regular review can boost confidence before an important examination.
boost.zh: 規律複習可以在重要考試前提升信心。

clarity.en: Good examples improve the clarity of a difficult explanation.
clarity.zh: 好的例子可以提升困難解釋的清楚程度。

coexist.en: Different viewpoints can coexist within the same classroom discussion.
coexist.zh: 不同觀點可以在同一場課堂討論中並存。

compelling.en: The speaker used compelling evidence to support the main argument.
compelling.zh: 講者使用有說服力的證據支持主要論點。

complement.en: The chart and written explanation complement each other in the report.
complement.zh: 圖表與文字說明在報告中彼此補充。

comprehensive.en: The final review provides a comprehensive summary of the entire unit.
comprehensive.zh: 期末複習提供整個單元的完整摘要。

conceal.en: Clouds can conceal the mountains from view on rainy days.
conceal.zh: 下雨天時，雲層可能會遮住山景。

concede.en: After checking the data, the group had to concede that its first idea was wrong.
concede.zh: 檢查資料後，小組不得不承認最初的想法有誤。

contemplate.en: Students should contemplate several solutions before choosing the final design.
contemplate.zh: 學生在選擇最終設計前應思考幾種解決方案。

contradict.en: The new evidence appears to contradict the earlier conclusion.
contradict.zh: 新的證據似乎與先前的結論互相矛盾。

conventional.en: The class compared a conventional method with a newer digital approach.
conventional.zh: 全班比較傳統方法與較新的數位方式。

crude.en: The first model was crude, but it helped the team test its idea.
crude.zh: 第一個模型雖然粗糙，但幫助團隊測試想法。

deem.en: The committee may deem the proposal acceptable after further review.
deem.zh: 委員會進一步審查後可能認定這項提案可以接受。

deficient.en: The report was deficient in evidence and needed more reliable sources.
deficient.zh: 這份報告缺乏證據，需要更多可靠來源。

deliberate.en: The judges will deliberate before announcing the final result.
deliberate.zh: 評審會在公布最後結果前仔細討論。

denounce.en: The editorial chose to denounce the spread of false information.
denounce.zh: 這篇社論選擇譴責錯誤資訊的散播。

detect.en: The sensor can detect small changes in temperature within seconds.
detect.zh: 感測器可以在數秒內偵測到微小的溫度變化。

deviate.en: The results may deviate slightly when room conditions change.
deviate.zh: 室內條件改變時，結果可能會有些微偏差。

elusive.en: A simple explanation remained elusive until the team collected more data.
elusive.zh: 直到團隊蒐集更多資料前，簡單的解釋仍難以找到。

empower.en: Access to reliable information can empower students to make better decisions.
empower.zh: 取得可靠資訊可以讓學生更有能力做出更好的決定。

equivalent.en: The two measurements are approximately equivalent after unit conversion.
equivalent.zh: 經過單位換算後，這兩個測量值大致相等。

exaggerate.en: Graphs should not exaggerate small differences by using a misleading scale.
exaggerate.zh: 圖表不應用誤導性的比例尺誇大小差異。

feeble.en: The feeble signal became stronger after the antenna was adjusted.
feeble.zh: 調整天線後，微弱的訊號變得更強。

formidable.en: The final project seemed formidable until the tasks were divided into smaller steps.
formidable.zh: 期末專題原本看似艱鉅，直到任務被拆成較小步驟。

frustrate.en: Unclear instructions can frustrate students during a difficult assignment.
frustrate.zh: 不清楚的指示可能讓學生在困難作業中感到挫折。

genuine.en: The researcher looked for genuine patterns rather than random differences.
genuine.zh: 研究人員尋找真正的規律，而不是隨機差異。

impartial.en: An impartial judge should evaluate every team by the same standard.
impartial.zh: 公正的評審應以相同標準評估每一隊。

inadequate.en: The first explanation was inadequate because it ignored important evidence.
inadequate.zh: 第一個解釋不夠充分，因為忽略了重要證據。

indispensable.en: Reliable data are indispensable when making a strong scientific conclusion.
indispensable.zh: 要做出有力的科學結論，可靠資料不可或缺。

inferior.en: The cheaper material proved inferior during the durability test.
inferior.zh: 較便宜的材料在耐用度測試中表現較差。

innovative.en: The students proposed an innovative way to reduce waste at school.
innovative.zh: 學生提出一個創新的方式來減少校園垃圾。

insightful.en: Her insightful question led the class to examine the issue more carefully.
insightful.zh: 她富有洞察力的問題讓全班更仔細檢視這個議題。

intricate.en: The diagram explains an intricate process using several simple stages.
intricate.zh: 這張圖用幾個簡單階段說明複雜的過程。

misleading.en: A misleading title can give readers the wrong impression about an article.
misleading.zh: 誤導性的標題可能讓讀者對文章產生錯誤印象。

moderate.en: A moderate amount of background noise did not affect the results.
moderate.zh: 適量的背景噪音並沒有影響結果。

obsolete.en: The school replaced several obsolete computers with newer models.
obsolete.zh: 學校用較新的機型取代了幾台過時的電腦。

pervasive.en: Smartphones have become pervasive tools in everyday communication.
pervasive.zh: 智慧型手機已成為日常溝通中普遍存在的工具。

preliminary.en: The preliminary results suggest that the new method may be effective.
preliminary.zh: 初步結果顯示新方法可能有效。

relevant.en: Include only relevant information when answering the reading question.
relevant.zh: 回答閱讀題時，只要包含相關資訊。

reliable.en: A reliable source explains its evidence and identifies where the information came from.
reliable.zh: 可靠的來源會說明證據，並指出資訊從何而來。

skeptical.en: Students should remain skeptical of claims that lack clear evidence.
skeptical.zh: 學生應對缺乏明確證據的主張保持懷疑。

sophisticated.en: The sophisticated model can analyze several variables at the same time.
sophisticated.zh: 這個精密模型可以同時分析數個變數。

sufficient.en: The available evidence was sufficient to support the final conclusion.
sufficient.zh: 現有證據足以支持最後的結論。

transparent.en: A transparent process makes it easier for everyone to understand how decisions were made.
transparent.zh: 透明的流程讓每個人更容易理解決策是如何形成的。

unbiased.en: An unbiased survey should avoid questions that guide people toward one answer.
unbiased.zh: 無偏見的問卷應避免引導受訪者選擇特定答案。

valid.en: The conclusion is valid only if the measurements were collected correctly.
valid.zh: 只有在測量資料蒐集正確時，這個結論才有效。

verify.en: Students should verify important facts before including them in a report.
verify.zh: 學生在把重要事實寫進報告前應先加以查證。

vivid.en: The writer used vivid details to describe the changing landscape.
vivid.zh: 作者用生動的細節描寫正在改變的景觀。
